Smt. Shiva @ Aditi vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 21 April,
2023
Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit

Bench: Vipin Chandra Dixit
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 69
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 42809 of 2022
Applicant :- Smt. Shiva @ Aditi

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Manish Kumar Singh,B.N.Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Heard learned counsel for applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present application has been filed by applicant seeking direction to Judicial Magistrate-II,
Kanpur Dehat for expeditious disposal of Complaint Case No. 432 of 2019 (Shiva @ Aditi vs. Rahul Kushwaha and another), under Sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kakwan, District Kanpur Nagar within a stipulated period.

entities.text: Complaint Case No. 432 of 2019 (Shiva @ Aditi vs. Rahul Kushwaha and another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for applicant that the applicant has filed a complaint in the year 2012 and notices were issued to the opposite parties.
The opposite parties have appeared before the court below and have been obtained bail.
It is further submitted that on account of delaying tactics adopted by opposite parties, the case could not be proceeded and is pending for disposal since 2012.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the Judicial Magistrate-II, Kanpur Dehat is Smt. Shiva @ Aditi vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74644178/
1 directed to decide the aforesaid complaint case, expeditiously and preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order, unless there is any legal impediment.

entities.text: Smt. Shiva @ Aditi vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: With the aforesaid directions, the application is disposed of.
